s00-02-story-b4251a.wav.text: The first four are all about God.

s00-03-talk-707bd3.wav.text: Then, before murder or stealing or lying, God talks about your mother and father.

s00-04-grave-88699e.wav.text: Honor your father and your mother,

s00-05-grave-b8b936.wav.text: that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.

s00-06-talk-91e7b2.wav.text: Most people hear that as a rule for little kids.

s01-01-story-eaaa04.wav.text: Many readers picture the commandments in two halves: loving God, then loving your neighbor.

s01-02-talk-9c9306.wav.text: And the very first neighbor God names is the one closest to you.

s01-04-story-fc876d.wav.text: So this command sits right on the hinge.

s02-01-pivot-e13775.wav.text: So what does honor actually mean?

s02-02-talk-74127c.wav.text: In Hebrew, the word for honor comes from a root that means heavy.

s02-03-talk-4fa6e7.wav.text: It's the same root as the word for glory.

s02-04-story-7d6dcd.wav.text: To honor your parents is to give them weight.

s02-07-story-4d3eec.wav.text: But a grown adult with grey-haired parents still honors them.

s03-01-pivot-8107ac.wav.text: And this command comes with something none of the others have.

s03-02-story-39c876.wav.text: The apostle Paul pointed it out.

s03-03-grave-8a21dc.wav.text: Honor your father and mother (this is the first commandment with a promise),

s03-04-grave-a26f31.wav.text: that it may go well with you and that you may live long in the land.

s03-05-talk-2c2bd2.wav.text: For Israel, it was about life in the land.

s03-06-story-8eba01.wav.text: Christians have long read it more widely: homes where parents are honored tend to hold together.

s04-01-pivot-c5adb2.wav.text: But what if your parents were hard to honor?

s04-02-talk-9cf042.wav.text: For some people, this commandment feels heavy in a different way.

s04-03-story-7100bb.wav.text: A parent who hurt them. A parent who left.

s04-05-talk-575666.wav.text: Honor is not the same as pretending.

s04-06-story-a2f8af.wav.text: It doesn't mean calling wrong things right, or staying in harm's way.

s04-07-talk-e7b97e.wav.text: Many Christian teachers put it like this: you can respect the place a parent holds,

s04-08-talk-6802f6.wav.text: while grieving what they did with it.

s04-09-story-a89829.wav.text: Then Paul turns straight to the parents too.

s04-10-grave-dd7ed3.wav.text: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger,

s04-11-grave-72a77e.wav.text: but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

s05-01-story-36e460.wav.text: And if a father or mother let you go, there is a line in the Psalms for you.

s05-02-grave-129e55.wav.text: For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the LORD will take me in.

s05-03-grave-c5b011.wav.text: Whoever let you go, God does not.

s06-02-story-cd71a9.wav.text: Jesus is dying, and his mother is standing there, watching.

s06-03-grave-b9b725.wav.text: When Jesus saw his mother and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to his mother, Woman,

s06-05-grave-c380c1.wav.text: Then he said to the disciple, Behold, your mother!

s06-06-grave-cf00d2.wav.text: And from that hour the disciple took her to his own home.

s06-07-talk-1d767a.wav.text: In the middle of his own suffering, he still made sure his mother had a home.

s06-08-story-bc4b0d.wav.text: He kept this commandment to the very end.

s07-01-talk-edc902.wav.text: So what does honor look like now?

s07-02-story-f394fa.wav.text: A phone call you keep putting off.

s07-03-story-794138.wav.text: Patience with a parent who is getting older.

s07-04-talk-4c8567.wav.text: And sometimes, it looks like forgiveness, from a safe distance.

s07-05-story-04a2a4.wav.text: Giving weight to the people who gave you a start.

s08-01-story-705ea0.wav.text: The fifth commandment is a doorway.

s08-02-story-024ab9.wav.text: Love for God walks through it, and arrives at home first.

s08-03-grave-760866.wav.text: Next time, the sixth commandment, and why every human life matters to God.
